name: Mawangnimeun Ulil Silheohae!
source:
You have achieved countless things in your quest to become the rightful Lord of Demons. During this difficult journey, three men appear right in the nick of time as you are in danger! Will you be able to claim the throne at the end of this journey?

[From in-app]
translation:
為成為名正言順的魔王，你已立下無數功績。在這段艱難的旅程中，每當你陷入危險，總有三位男子及時出現！旅途終點，你能成功登上王座嗎？

[摘自App內的]
